cases.description: Removing the reduce initial value breaks the promised zero for an empty collection.
cases.before: function probe() { return [].reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0); }
cases.after: function probe() { return [].reduce((a, b) => a + b); }

cases.description: Unknown token counters must remain null; converting unknown to zero hides missing observations.
cases.before: function probe() { const tokens = null; return tokens; }
cases.after: function probe() { const tokens = null; return tokens ?? 0; }

cases.description: The queued path drops the response while direct dispatch still replies.
cases.before: function probe() { const queued = true; const response = 'answer'; return queued ? response : response; }
cases.after: function probe() { const queued = true; const response = 'answer'; return queued ? undefined : response; }

cases.description: A source-preserving refactor must retain its coverage and must not acquire an invented defect.
cases.after: function probe() { const total = 2 + 3; return total; }
